elements.title: Salient Statistics—United States
elements.content:
|                         | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023e |
|-------------------------|-------|-------|-------|-------|--------|
| Production              | W     | W     | W     | W     | W      |
| Imports for consumption | 2,620 | 2,460 | 2,640 | 3,270 | 3,400  |
| Exports                 | 1,660 | 1,200 | 1,870 | 2,440 | 2,300  |
| Consumption, apparent¹  | W     | W     | W     | W     | W      |
| Price, annual average-nominal, battery-grade lithium carbonate, dollars per metric ton² | 12,100 | 8,600 | 12,600 | 68,100 | 46,000 |
| Employment, mine and mill, number | 70 | 70 | 70 | 70 | 70 |
| Net import reliance³ as a percentage of apparent consumption | >25 | >50 | >25 | >25 | >25 |
elements.notes:
¹ Apparent consumption = Production + Imports - Exports
² Price is for battery-grade lithium carbonate
³ Net import reliance = (Imports - Exports) / Apparent Consumption
